import msvcrt, os, tempfile, json

with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False) as tf:
    p = tf.name

try:
    with open(p, 'w+b') as f1:
        f1.write(json.dumps({'pid': 1234, 'time': 5678}).encode())
        f1.flush()
        f1.seek(0)
        msvcrt.locking(f1.fileno(), msvcrt.LK_NBLCK, 1)
        
        # Now try to read from f2
        with open(p, 'rb') as f2:
            data = f2.read()
            print('Read under lock:', data)
            
        # Try to lock from f2
        with open(p, 'r+b') as f3:
            try:
                msvcrt.locking(f3.fileno(), msvcrt.LK_NBLCK, 1)
                print('Lock succeeded unexpectedly!')
            except OSError as e:
                print('Lock correctly blocked:', e)
        
        f1.seek(0)
        msvcrt.locking(f1.fileno(), msvcrt.LK_UNLCK, 1)
finally:
    os.unlink(p)
